declared.title: What's Advertising Content Worth? Evidence from a Consumer Credit Marketing Field Experiment
declared.foundIn: rapport contre-preuve reports/too-many-choices/counter-evidence.md (2026-11-22), DOI trouvé par ses requêtes ; titre relevé sur Crossref par la session : contrôle d'identité plus faible

population: clients of a South African consumer lender who received randomized direct-mail loan offers; sample size not given in the abstract

findings.text: Showing fewer example loans in a mail offer raised loan take-up about as much as a large cut in the interest rate

support.sentence: Showing fewer example loans, not suggesting a particular use for the loan, or including a photo of an attractive woman increases loan demand by about as much as a 25% reduction in the interest rate.

limits: example loans shown in an advertisement, not a choice among options one must pick from
taking a loan is not a good outcome in itself
South Africa: not a Middle East or North African sample
